newsitem.title: USA: Micron Electronics Q3 net rises 40 percent.
newsitem.headline: Micron Electronics Q3 net rises 40 percent.

text.p: Micron Electronics Inc said Monday its fiscal third quarter net income rose 40 percent, less than Wall Street expected and that it could face more pressure in coming months.
The PC maker said net income for the quarter ended May 29 rose to $19.7 million, or $0.20 a share, from $14.1 million, or $0.15 a share, in the same quarter a year ago.
Wall Street expected Micron Electronics, based in Nampa, Idaho, to earn $0.24 a share, according to a recent survey by Zacks Investment Research.
Revenue for the third quarter rose 24 percent to $511.4 million from $412.3 million.

Micron said its results were less than expected as customers chose to buy its lower-priced personal computers. The company also continues to see pressure on its gross margins -- a measure of how much money it makes on each dollar of product sold -- as PC prices fall.
